payload.text: Readqc failed on coverage for a tumor library. What minimum coverage applies now, and does any of our documentation say otherwise?

payload.arguments: {"query":"readqc tumor library minimum coverage threshold current effective documentation","sources":["qms","wiki","ticketing"],"doc_types":["sop","validation","wiki_page","incident","service_request","change_request","problem"],"applies_to":"readqc","include_inactive":false,"limit":8}
payload.name: search_knowledge

matches.snippet:
Readqc fails when a selected library's coverage is below the confirmed minimum coverage.
Normal and germline libraries require a mean coverage of at least 30x.
Tumor libraries intended for somatic calling require a mean coverage of at least 40x.
The 40x tumor minimum replaced the earlier 30x minimum on 2025-11-03 under change CHG-0021.
Confirm min_coverage 40 when preparing a readqc draft for tumor libraries.
Report…
matches.title: Read Quality and Low Purity Review

Owner: quality lead | Approvers: qa-officer, lab-director
## 1. Purpose
This procedure defines read quality review for libraries analyzed in the Zagent workbench.

Type: change_request | Status: resolved | Priority: high | Site: all
Components: readqc, somatic-snv
Created: 2025-10-22 | Resolved: 2025-11-03
Links: SOP-QC-001, VAL-WGS-2025
## Description
Raise the minimum mean coverage for tumor libraries used in somatic calling from 30x to 40x, based on VAL-WGS-2025.
matches.title: Raise the tumor minimum coverage to 40x

matches.snippet:
| 60x | 99.6 percent | 98.8 percent |
Germline SNV sensitivity was 99.1 percent at 30x mean coverage.
Somatic SNV sensitivity at 0.10 VAF rose from 91.2 percent at 30x to 96.4 percent at 40x.
## Conclusions
A 30x minimum is adequate for germline panels.
The results support a higher minimum for tumor libraries, which was adopted later under CHG-0021.
## Limitations
Reference materials do not reproduce formalin damage…

payload.text:
The current minimum is **40× mean coverage** for tumor libraries intended for somatic calling. The effective SOP says the 40× threshold replaced the earlier 30× minimum on 2025-11-03 and instructs analysts to set `min_coverage` to 40 for tumor-library readqc drafts. [sop-qc-001-v3@3:L10-L12]

There is documentation that may seem to say otherwise: the resolved change request notes that the workbench’s **default remains 30×**, but tells analysts to set 40× for tumor libraries. That default is not the current tumor requirement. [chg-0021@2025-11-03:L12-L15]
